prompt: The panel owns the capture session today: its own process spawns the Python agent, so nothing else in the system knows when a session is running, and a second start has nothing to stop it. Move the session lifecycle into the bot core. Add src/bot/capture-session.ts exporting a CaptureSession class with start(), stop() and status(): it spawns the agent process, reports { state, pid, startedAt } where state is one of idle, starting, running or stopping, refuses a second start while it is running and does not spawn twice, returns to idle when the child exits, and treats stop as idempotent. The process factory must be injectable as a spawnProcess option ({ command, args, cwd, spawnProcess }) so the session can be exercised without launching Python or touching an audio device.
